name: Assess
summary: Baseline enterprise AI transformation capability, identify constraints and establish evidence for action.

name: Architect
summary: Design target capabilities, operating model, enterprise AI architecture, governance and transformation roadmap.

name: Prove
summary: Use focused prototypes or proofs of value to test assumptions and create evidence before scaling.

name: Transform
summary: Embed, scale and govern the capabilities required for sustainable enterprise AI outcomes.

name: Build Capability
summary: Develop organisational capability through assessment-led learning, applied workshops, labs, coaching and validation.
